issues.title: BLU-013 Teach Mode draft workflow builder

criteria.requirement: Unknown steps flagged and generated drafts cannot auto-execute

tests.name: unknown and malformed observations require review
preview flags unknown steps and never authorizes execution

criteria.requirement: Happy path and malformed input tested; host-dependent failure scenarios require integration

tests.name: empty observations are safe and immutable
preview handles empty and malformed observations deterministically

criteria.requirement: Pure draft builder discards unrecognized data and never invokes host or network

tests.name: ac3 teach capture retains no payloads and uses no io or network
ac1 review is read-only and abort discards preview
ac2 validation is deterministic and every refusal is explicit

criteria.requirement: Flutter analysis and relevant tests pass with reproducible CI evidence
criteria.reason: flutter analyze and the named suites run on every PR CI; native macOS device validation when drafts are integrated remains the documented manual lane.
